audioFormat.title: Output format
audioFormat.description: Preferred output format. m4a (AAC) recommended for browser playback; mp3 for legacy compatibility.

userAgent.title: User‑Agent
userAgent.description: Optional browser User‑Agent string to mimic your browser session.

cookiesTxt.title: Netscape cookies.txt (optional)
cookiesTxt.description: Paste Netscape cookies including .google.com and .youtube.com entries, or upload a file/URL (fileupload).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Select Apify Proxy or provide custom proxies. Optional.

formatExpr.title: yt‑dlp format expression
formatExpr.description: Advanced: override yt‑dlp format selection expression.

uploadUrl.title: GCS signed PUT URL (optional)
uploadUrl.description: If provided, the Actor will PUT the audio directly to this URL instead of storing in KVS.

callbackUrl.title: Callback URL (optional)
callbackUrl.description: Hono webhook to call on completion. The Actor POSTs status + metadata as JSON.

callbackSecret.title: Callback HMAC secret (optional)
callbackSecret.description: If set, the Actor signs the raw JSON body with HMAC-SHA256 in X-Signature.

jobId.title: Job ID (optional)
jobId.description: Correlation ID echoed to logs and callback payload for easier tracing.
